d: This is a high-quality switch mode power supply (SMPS) that converts AC to DC 5V with up to 200W output power. It’s highly efficient and widely used as a power adapter, power supply for led light strips, LED display, billboard, industrial equipment, etc.
AC input voltage range(V): AC 110V/220V±15% (switch replacement)
Start time, hold-up time(ms): Ton?200ms,Td?30ms @230Vac Full Load
